artifact: HES Trade Agent Controlled Signal Research Protocol v1
objective: Explore whether a reproducible candidate signal specification can be defined without treating E0/E1 winners as independent confirmations.
allowed: feature combinations using the frozen feature contract
out-of-evidence validation on data not used to construct E0/E1
forbidden: threshold selection using the 14 nominal winners
reusing E0/E1 winner rows as independent confirmations
model fitting whose target or hyperparameters are selected from E0/E1 results
retroactive alteration of the locked evidence matrix

feature_guidance.interpretation: These labels are descriptive research context, not feature rankings or selection decisions.

required_research_split.construction_data: new data outside the frozen E0/E1 snapshot
